rules: Retain economics, policy, industry or market studies when salmon aquaculture/farming is itself a substantive production system, exposure, market force or supply-chain component being analysed. Commercial seafood terminology or a statement that salmon is usually farmed is insufficient by itself.

For reviews, books and proceedings, retain where eligible salmonids and aquaculture form a substantive reviewed topic, chapter, section, dataset or production application. Exclude where salmon/rainbow trout is merely an illustrative example or aquaculture appears only as generic future relevance, keywords, affiliation or journal context.
Retain wild/ecological studies where farming conditions or aquaculture are directly part of the study design or explanatory context.
